description: Creates and revokes project access tokens.

parameters.name: access_level
parameters.description: Access level of the access token. The value planner was added in community.general 11.3.0. Choices: "guest" "planner" "reporter" "developer" "maintainer" ← (default) "owner"

parameters.name: api_job_token
parameters.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_oauth_token
parameters.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

parameters.name: expires_at
parameters.description: Expiration date of the access token in YYYY-MM-DD format. Make sure to quote this value in YAML to ensure it is kept as a string and not interpreted as a YAML date.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: ID or full path of project in the form of group/name.

parameters.name: recreate
parameters.description: Whether the access token is recreated if it already exists. When never the token is never recreated. When always the token is always recreated. When state_change the token is recreated if there is a difference between desired state and actual state. Choices: "never" ← (default) "always" "state_change"

parameters.name: scopes
parameters.description: Scope of the access token. The values manage_runner and self_rotate were added in community.general 11.3.0. Choices: "api" "read_api" "read_registry" "write_registry" "read_repository" "write_repository" "create_runner" "manage_runner" "ai_features" "k8s_proxy" "self_rotate"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: When present the access token is added to the project if it does not exist. When absent it is removed from the project if it exists. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: "Creating a project access token"
  community.general.gitlab_project_access_token:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "somegitlabapitoken"
    project: "my_group/my_project"
    name: "project_token"
    expires_at: "2024-12-31"
    access_level: developer
    scopes:
      - api
      - read_api
      - read_repository
      - write_repository
    state: present

- name: "Revoking a project access token"
  community.general.gitlab_project_access_token:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "somegitlabapitoken"
    project: "my_group/my_project"
    name: "project_token"
    expires_at: "2024-12-31"
    scopes:
      - api
      - read_api
      - read_repository
      - write_repository
    state: absent

- name: "Change (recreate) existing token if its actual state is different than desired state"
  community.general.gitlab_project_access_token:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "somegitlabapitoken"
    project: "my_group/my_project"
    name: "project_token"
    expires_at: "2024-12-31"
    scopes:
      - api
      - read_api
      - read_repository
      - write_repository
    recreate: state_change
    state: present

return_values.name: access_token
return_values.description: API object. Only contains the value of the token if the token was created or recreated. Returned: success and state=present
